# The match Expression in Depth
`match` enables exhaustive pattern matching. Every possible case must be handled.

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
enum Priority {
    Low,
    Medium,
    High,
    Critical(u8),
}

fn inspect_priority(p: Priority) {
    match p {
        Priority::Low => println!("Low priority - queue normally"),
        Priority::Medium => println!("Medium priority - assign SLA"),
        Priority::High => println!("High priority - alert on-call"),
        Priority::Critical(level) => println!("CRITICAL (level {}) - page team immediately", level),
    }
}

fn main() {
    inspect_priority(Priority::High);
    inspect_priority(Priority::Critical(1));
}
```
